display.purpose: Hero headlines and single defining page statements. DM Serif Display only — never in Source Sans 3.

headline.purpose: Section headers, tour names, blog titles. DM Serif Display.

title.purpose: Card titles, subsection labels. Source Sans 3 Semi-Bold.

body.purpose: Running prose. Source Sans 3. Max line length 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, trust badges, navigation items, attribute tags. Always uppercase and tracked at 0.25em.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Rare rest-state lift when tonal layering alone is insufficient. Use sparingly.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Applied on card hover. Communicates that the element is responding to attention.

shadows.name: luxury-frame
shadows.purpose: Tour cards on hover only. The 1px gold ring and deep shadow arrive together — a loupe around a field photograph.

motion.name: ease-out-smooth
motion.purpose: Hero reveal animations. Fast deceleration — confident entrance.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions: nav underline, card lift, button fill.

motion.name: ease-luxury
motion.purpose: Luxury card hover lift. Slightly slower deceleration for premium feel.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Focus rings, opacity transitions, small state changes.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Nav underline, button hover fill, card border.

motion.name: duration-hero
motion.purpose: Hero reveal stagger. Each element staggers by 150ms.

components.name: Ghost Gold Button
components.description: Standard UI button. Transparent fill with gold border — becomes gold-filled on hover. Default action in non-conversion contexts.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 24px; height: 40px; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #d4af37; color: #d4af37; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost-gold:hover { background: #d4af37; color: #1c1c1c; } .ds-btn-ghost-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4af37; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost-gold:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: CTA Button
components.description: Primary conversion button. Monsoon Honey fill (darker gold, WCAG AA on white). One per section maximum. Used for Book, Inquire, WhatsApp actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 40px; height: 48px; background: #b8960f; border: none; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: #a3850e; } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4af37; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-cta:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Hero Primary Button
components.description: Used on dark hero overlay. White text with gold border — becomes gold-filled on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 40px; height: 48px; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #d4af37; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-hero-primary:hover { background: #d4af37; color: #1c1c1c; } .ds-btn-hero-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4af37; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: The structural fingerprint of the system. Gold eyebrow → DM Serif Display headline → 64px gold rule. Every major section uses this pattern.
components.html:
OUR TOURS

Off-Road Adventures in Chiang Mai
components.css: .ds-section-heading { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; } .ds-section-eyebrow { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #d4af37; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-section-title { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.25rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; color: #1c1c1c; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-gold-divider { display: block; height: 1px; width: 64px; background: #d4af37; margin: 0 auto; }

components.name: Gold Divider
components.description: The 64px gold rule used as a section separator. A stamped mark, not a wall — never full-width.
components.css: .ds-gold-divider { display: block; height: 1px; width: 64px; background: #d4af37; margin: 0 auto; }

components.css: .ds-tour-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fdfbf7; border: 1px solid #e8e2da; border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), box-shadow 0.4s ease; } .ds-tour-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.2), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.15); } .ds-tour-card__image { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tour-card__image-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #e8e2da; } .ds-tour-card__badge { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-tour-card__body { padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-tour-card__title { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3; color: #1c1c1c; margin: 0; } .ds-tour-card__desc { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b6560; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; } .ds-tour-card__chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1); color: #d4af37; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Attribute Chip
components.description: Document annotations for tour attributes (Kosher, Private, Shabbat Friendly). Gold tint background, near-square corner.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1); color: #d4af37; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Slightly softer radius than buttons (4px) — receptive, not assertive. Gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #faf7f2; border: 1px solid #e8e2da; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #2c2c2c; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #d4af37; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(212,175,55,0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6560; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.description: Transparent on hero, parchment/blur on scroll. Logo scales down. Nav links expand gold underline from center on hover.

components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 32px; height: 72px; transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav--scrolled { background: rgba(250,247,242,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2); } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 400; color: #1c1c1c; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav__link { position: relative; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2c2c2c; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -2px; left: 50%; width: 0; height: 1px; background: #d4af37; transition: width 0.3s ease, left 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav__link:hover::after { width: 100%; left: 0; } .ds-nav__link--active::after { width: 100%; left: 0; }

narrative.overview:
This is a well-worn travel document that proves real experience happened. DM Serif Display headlines cut sharp against parchment-toned backgrounds. Temple Gold appears as printed ink — the stamp on a field envelope, the underline in a handwritten note, the ruled margin in a jungle notebook. Photography is primary documentation, not decoration. Every screen should feel like a page you'd find tucked inside a guide's kit bag, not a brochure you'd pick up in a hotel lobby.

The system rejects the logistics-heavy corporate aesthetic of Thailand Kosher, Kesher Tours, and Koco Travel — travel agency layouts with group-bus-tour energy, dense itinerary tables, and 'traditional Jewish vacation' positioning. It equally rejects generic adventure tourism with stock photography and countdown timers, budget backpacker neon-and-clutter, and the cold distance of sterile luxury hotel design.

Density is intentional. The site breathes. Whitespace is the jungle clearing between dense canopy sections.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment surfaces (#faf7f2, #fdfbf7) — never clinical white
Near-zero corner radius (0px) on action elements: printed, not rounded
Temple Gold used at trace-element concentration — dividers, borders, underlines, focus rings
DM Serif Display at confident scale; contrast with Source Sans 3's open warmth
Uppercase tracking labels as structural document markers
Bilingual Hebrew/English as a first-class constraint, not an afterthought

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Temple Gold appears on ≤10% of any given screen surface. A gold element draws the eye because everything around it is not gold. Filling backgrounds, cards, or non-CTA buttons with gold destroys the signal entirely.

rules.name: The Warm Surface Rule
rules.body: Every background surface must carry warmth. Rice Paper for pages. Field Notes Cream for cards. Teak Dust for borders. Pure white (#ffffff) is prohibited on surfaces — it breaks the dossier illusion.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every major section opens with a label-weight uppercase tracker in Temple Gold before the DM Serif Display headline. The sequence — gold eyebrow → serif headline → 64px gold rule — is the structural fingerprint. New sections that skip the eyebrow lose their chapter identity.

rules.name: The Type-Mixing Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display is for headings. Source Sans 3 is for everything else. Never set body copy in DM Serif Display, and never set a headline in Source Sans without intent. Hebrew headings use Rubik; Hebrew body uses Heebo.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest is flat. The shadow is a state — hover, focus, overlay — not a decorative property. A card with a shadow at rest and a stronger shadow on hover has lost the signal.

dos: Do use Temple Gold exclusively for borders, dividers, underlines, focus rings, and the single filled CTA button. The ratio on any screen must stay below 10%.
Do use 0px radius (rounded-sm) on tour cards, buttons, and attribute chips. The sharp corner is intentional — it signals printed, not digital.
Do open every major section with a label-weight uppercase eyebrow in Temple Gold, followed by a DM Serif Display headline, followed by a 64px centered gold divider.
Do load all Hebrew content with [lang="he"] or .rtl, Heebo/Rubik fonts, and dir="rtl". Bilingual is a first-class contract.
Do apply the Luxury Frame shadow only on tour cards and only on hover.
Do register every new animation with the prefers-reduced-motion kill switch already in index.css.
Do keep all body copy on Rice Paper (#faf7f2) or Field Notes Cream (#fdfbf7). Warm surfaces only.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on any card, list item, callout, or alert. The tour card's current border-l-4 border-accent pattern is prohibited and must not spread.
Don't use gradient text via background-clip: text. The .wiro-gold-shimmer and .gold-shimmer utilities are prohibited for new components. Use solid color: #d4af37 instead.
Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as any background surface. Rice Paper is the minimum warmth.
Don't design new pages to look like Thailand Kosher, Kesher Tours, or Koco Travel. If it looks like a travel agency, it has failed.
Don't use countdown timers, 'X spots left' urgency badges, or stock photography of anonymous tourists.
Don't fill any large surface with Temple Gold or Monsoon Honey. Gold is a trace element.
Don't apply a drop shadow to any surface at rest. Shadows are earned by state change.
Don't ship a new page section without Hebrew copy equivalents. English-only sections do not exist in this product.
